description: This file defines a C# class that extends a Grain and implements an interface for testing a grain service in an Orleans-based project. It contains methods that invoke a client service to perform various operations such as retrieving a greeting, checking if processes have started, and echoing messages.

classes.name: GrainServiceTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class that interacts with a grain service client to perform various service-related operations.

methods.name: GetHelloWorldUsingCustomService
methods.description: Invokes the client to retrieve a greeting message.

methods.name: CallHasStarted
methods.description: Checks if the service has started.

methods.name: CallHasStartedInBackground
methods.description: Checks if the service has started in background.

methods.name: CallHasInit
methods.description: Checks if the service has been initialized.

methods.name: EchoViaExtension
methods.description: Echoes a message via an extension method.
